episodes.title: Track of the Cat
episodes.summary: Anna questions the official explanation when the death of a fellow ranger unsettles the park.

episodes.title: Hide + Seek
episodes.summary: As Anna Pigeon settles into a more complicated personal life in the park, she discovers a game of hide and seek has taken a dangerous turn; intent on helping a family in crisis, Anna and the other rangers must make a decision that will affect the family's future.

episodes.title: The Preacher
episodes.summary: An explosion at the park draws Anna into a case beyond its borders.

episodes.title: Hell Is Other People
episodes.summary: Anna guides a tense group of campers through the backcountry as a fierce storm closes in.

episodes.title: The Rope
episodes.summary: Anna fights for survival while her friends race to uncover what happened to her.

episodes.title: There's Always a Road
episodes.summary: The rangers are tested by the difficult investigation into Anna's disappearance.

episodes.title: The Three Matt Skweikis
episodes.summary: A naked, glowing man with no memory leads Anna and Frederick to unravel a decades-old mystery.

episodes.title: Nature Nurture
episodes.summary: A shooting hits close to home as Molly visits to find Anna's life more complicated than it seems.
